stories.headline: First Pakistani astronaut reaches China's Tiangong station
stories.summary: Shenzhou-24 docked with Tiangong on 25 November; Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is the first Pakistani in orbit and the first foreign astronaut aboard China's space station.

stories.headline: Petrobras approves $122bn five-year investment plan
stories.summary: Brazil's state oil giant approved a $122 billion plan for 2027–2031, targeting record output of 2.9 million barrels a day and paying $2.6 billion in extra dividends.

stories.headline: Carney unveils aid for steel and lumber, new steel tariffs
stories.summary: PM Mark Carney announced support for steel and lumber hit by US tariffs, tighter quotas on foreign steel and a 25% global tariff on steel-derivative imports.

stories.headline: Russia's own figures show nearly 500,000 lost in Ukraine war
stories.summary: Leaked records from Russia's Rosstat agency, analysed by the BBC, show at least 490,334 Russian soldiers have died since the invasion began in February 2022.

stories.headline: Colombia marks 10 years since historic peace deal
stories.summary: A decade after the 2016 accord with the FARC ended 50 years of war, UN chief Guterres urges Colombia to finish implementing it as violence persists where the state never reached.

stories.headline: Bangladesh raises garment workers' minimum wage 36%
stories.summary: After weeks of protests that shut factories, the wage board raised the minimum to 17,000 taka (about $136) a month from 12,500, effective 1 December.
